# Zephyr RTOS Kconfig fragment for TLS‑secured TCP networking (native_sim)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Enable the networking stack with BSD socket support
# --------------------------------------------------------------------
CONFIG_NETWORKING=y

CONFIG_NET_IPV6=y

CONFIG_NET_SOCKETS=y
CONFIG_NET_SOCKETS_POSIX_API=y

# --------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Enable TLS socket options so applications can use secure sockets

CONFIG_NET_SOCKETS_TLS=y

CONFIG_TLS_CREDENTIALS=y

CONFIG_MBEDTLS_DEBUG_LEVEL=1
